verdict.rationale: Floot's own sharing docs say you can add collaborators to a project, so team members can work on the same project. This rests on a single brief mention, with no detail on a team-level shared workspace, roles or permissions, or simultaneous editing. Missing for 10: a documented team/shared workspace, collaborator roles and permissions, real-time or concurrent co-editing behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my team can work on the same project together in a shared workspace

citations.quote: add collaborators, send a development preview, send the whole project to another account, or make the project public
